channel.title: The Dig — Spin qubit devices and figures of merit
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Spin qubit devices and figures of merit preset. Today’s ranked reading list centers on near-term spin-qubit QPU readout, compilation, and control, led by 2611.23448 on ADC-less cryogenic readout, 2611.22315 on connectivity-aware routing and resynthesis, and 2611.24886 on calibration- and noise-aware superconducting compilation; the remaining skims broaden the fault-tolerant and QEC context through 2611.24328 on real-time Pauli-frame tracking, 2611.23919 on minimal-control fault-tolerant architectures, 2611.23009 on dual-rail compilation, 2611.23420 on high-rate low-distance color codes, and 2611.23528 on singlet-flag shuttled qLDPC codes in silicon.
